Summary: Verify that the assigned triage tier is always displayed together with its rubric-referenced rationale — never the tier alone with no exception for the routine tier
Description: Validates that every assigned triage tier is displayed together with its rubric-referenced rationale in every case including the routine tier.
Step Action: Complete an intake session that results in a triage tier being assigned (routine)
Step Expected Result: The assigned triage tier is displayed together with its rubric-referenced rationale — never the tier alone

Summary: Verify that the UI/copy presents the tier as a suggestion for clinician review — never as a diagnosis a directive or a decision already made
Description: Validates that the UI/copy frames the assigned tier as a suggestion for clinician review rather than a diagnosis directive or decision already made.
Step Action: Open a completed intake's structured note and triage tier in the clinician dashboard
Step Expected Result: The tier is presented with suggestion language (e.g. 'suggested urgency' / 'recommended for review') — never as a diagnosis a directive or a decision already made

Summary: Verify that the clinician can open the full structured note from the same view as the tier so the basis for the recommendation is always independently reviewable
Description: Validates that the clinician can open the full structured note (chief complaint HPI relevant history flagged concerns) from the same view as the triage tier.
Step Action: From the clinician dashboard queue open a patient's triage tier entry
Step Expected Result: The full structured note (chief complaint HPI relevant history flagged concerns) is reachable from the same view as the tier — the basis for the recommendation is independently reviewable and not just a number

Summary: Verify that a clinician authenticated for one clinic cannot view another clinic's patient queue by any navigation path
Description: Validates that a clinician logged in for one clinic cannot view another clinic's patient queue through any navigation path in the dashboard.
Step Action: As a clinician authenticated for Clinic A attempt every discoverable navigation path to Clinic B's patient queue
Step Expected Result: Access is denied for all attempted paths — Clinic B's queue is never shown to a Clinic A clinician

Summary: Verify that a clinician cannot open another clinic's structured note by direct URL/ID manipulation even with an otherwise-valid session
Description: Validates that a clinician with an otherwise-valid session cannot open another clinic's structured note by manipulating the note URL or ID directly.
Step Action: As a clinician authenticated for Clinic A manipulate a structured-note URL/ID to reference a Clinic B patient
Step Expected Result: Access is denied — the Clinic B structured note is never rendered for the Clinic A clinician's session

Summary: Verify that a patient intake session is scoped to the clinic its kiosk/pre-visit link belongs to and never appears in another clinic's queue or reporting
Description: Validates that a patient intake session started via a specific clinic's kiosk or pre-visit link is scoped only to that clinic and never surfaces in another clinic's queue or reporting.
Step Action: Complete a patient intake session via Clinic A's kiosk/pre-visit link
Step Expected Result: The resulting session appears only in Clinic A's queue/reporting and never in any other clinic's queue or reporting

Summary: Verify that a patient logging in with an MR number or registered phone number is matched to their own record via an exact identifier match — never a fuzzy or partial match that could resolve to a different patient
Description: Validates that patient login matches the patient to their own record via an exact identifier match and never a fuzzy or partial match that could resolve to a different patient.
Step Action: Log in with a valid MR number or registered phone number and a correct OTP
Step Expected Result: The system matches the patient to their own record via an exact identifier match — never a fuzzy or partial match that could resolve to a different patient

Summary: Verify that a login attempt with an MR number or phone number that doesn't exactly match any existing patient record is rejected outright never silently matched to the nearest similar record
Description: Validates that a login attempt with an identifier that doesn't exactly match any existing patient record is rejected outright rather than silently matched to the nearest similar record.
Step Action: Attempt to log in with an MR number or phone number that doesn't exactly match any existing patient record
Step Expected Result: The login attempt is rejected outright — never silently matched to the nearest similar record

Summary: Verify that two patients with plausibly similar identifiers (e.g. typo-adjacent phone numbers; similar MR numbers) never have their intake data merged or cross-attached to the wrong record
Description: Validates that two patients with plausibly similar identifiers never have their intake data merged or cross-attached to the wrong record.
Step Action: Two patients exist with plausibly similar identifiers (e.g. typo-adjacent phone numbers; similar MR numbers); one completes an intake session
Step Expected Result: The intake data attaches only to the correct patient's record — never merged or cross-attached to the other patient's record
